items.question: How much, in total, did client number 617 pay for all of the transactions in 1998?
items.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T3.amount) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T4.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3.date)= '1998' AND T1.client_id = 617
items.note: The query filters to one client, and every client has exactly one disp row, so each trans row is joined once. The guard cannot see this data-level uniqueness from the SQL.
items.rewrite_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 617) AND STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1998'

notes: Verdicts are the author's manual reading, not BIRD labels.
Only SUM is checked; AVG over repeated rows is outside the guard.
Questions that were not reviewed are not claimed to be correct.
